definitionZh: @import CSS at- rule 用于从其他有效样式表导入样式规则 。 @ import 规则必须在样式表的顶端下定义, 在其它规则( 除了 @ charset 和 @layer) 和样式声明之前, 否则会被忽略 。
sourceDefinition: The @import CSS at-rule is used to import style rules from other valid stylesheets. An @import rule must be defined at the top of the stylesheet, before any other at-rule (except @charset and @layer) and style declarations, or it will be ignored.
